title: Vell is standing right beside me when I finally sit Marrowgate's throne — the exact city his hidden secret is about — but his reaction line ('says nothing at all, which is the worst thing Vell has ever said') is generic and never touches his own unresolved plot, which felt like a missed beat given how much buildup his 'goes quiet at Marrowgate' hook got.
